service.description: CLI grants across tenants with their state and the sign-in lifetime they give, by tenant, user or status.
Turns the CLI on for a member of the tenant, with an optional end; the user's earlier grant there is revoked.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: The grant ends this many days (each 24 hours) from the start, or from now when changing a grant. Neither days nor thruDate: no end.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.create#CliAccessGrant', targetType: 'CliAccessGrant', targetId: grant.grantId, detailText: 'Turned the CLI on for user ' + userId + ' in tenant ' + tenantUserGroupId + ', ends ' + (grant.thruDate ?: 'never') + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: The grant ends this many days (each 24 hours) from the start, or from now when changing a grant. Neither days nor thruDate: no end.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.update#CliAccessGrant', targetType: 'CliAccessGrant', targetId: grantId, detailText: 'Changed CLI grant ' + grantId + ': ends ' + (grant.thruDate ?: 'never') + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Pauses an active CLI grant; the user's CLI stops in that tenant on their next call.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.pause#CliAccessGrant', targetType: 'CliAccessGrant', targetId: grantId, detailText: 'Paused CLI grant ' + grantId + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Lifts a pause, optionally with a later end; refused when the grant has ended.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: The grant ends this many days (each 24 hours) from the start, or from now when changing a grant. Neither days nor thruDate: no end.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.unpause#CliAccessGrant', targetType: 'CliAccessGrant', targetId: grantId, detailText: 'Unpaused CLI grant ' + grantId + ': ends ' + (grant.thruDate ?: 'never') + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Revokes a CLI grant; the user has no CLI in that tenant until granted again.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.revoke#CliAccessGrant', targetType: 'CliAccessGrant', targetId: grantId, detailText: 'Revoked CLI grant ' + grantId + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: CLI access requests across tenants, newest first; PENDING unless a status is given.
Turns the CLI on as asked (a grant with the given end) and marks the request approved. Refused when the request is not pending or the user is no longer a member.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: The grant ends this many days (each 24 hours) from now. Neither days nor thruDate: no end.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.CliAccessAdminServices.approve#CliAccessRequest', targetType: 'CliAccessRequest', targetId: requestId, detailText: 'Approved CLI request ' + requestId + ' for user ' + request.userId + ' in tenant ' + request.tenantUserGroupId + ' as grant ' + grant.grantId + ', ends ' + (grant.thruDate ?: 'never') + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Declines a pending request; the note, when given, is shown to the user, who may ask again.

parameter.name: decisionNote
parameter.description: Shown to the user (optional, at most 500 characters).
